task: workspace membership invitations & tenant ML boundaries; audit tenant isolation in ML inference and persistent RAG store (kb_sources, kb_documents partitioned per tenant), ensure no cross-tenant knowledge retrieval leakage.
interface_assumptions: Tenant identifiers are alphanumeric strings up to 128 characters without path traversal (..) or path separators.
Un-tenanted/public queries (tenant_id is empty or None) access only public/global knowledge; private tenant knowledge is never exposed.
Workspace membership invitation lifecycle states: active, invited, pending, expired, revoked, suspended.
Pending or invited status strictly denies tenant-scoped inference access with HTTP 403; invitations do not grant ML capability until accepted.
KbSourceRegistry and KbDocument tables support nullable tenant_id with idx_kb_source_registry_tenant and idx_kb_documents_tenant indexes.
HybridRetriever dense search and SparseIndex BM25 search strictly filter documents by tenant_id, allowing only the requested tenant or global knowledge.
SemanticQueryCache exact keys and vector-similarity candidate matches are isolated by tenant_id, preventing cross-tenant retrieval cache leakage.
Error envelopes for tenant boundary violations return HTTP 403 with zero PII or PHI.
